versions.changelog:
analyze-burn-economics v0.1.0

- Initial release offering governance-grade analysis of Uniswap Firepit burn economics.
- Automates historical P&L per burn, fee accumulation trends, and burn frequency insights.
- Includes comprehensive data collection: burn events, UNI price history, accumulation rates, and firepit state.
- Provides historical reports and governance-relevant profitability projections.
- Designed strictly for analytical use—no execution or real-time monitoring capabilities.
